actions.action: Early pay up to 2 days early, permanently

decisions.message: Planned upgrade: from Sat Dec 12, 12:00 AM to about noon Sun Dec 13 (CT) we move to a new banking system. You will see your balance, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. Card payments keep working offline up to $250 each. It may run a few hours longer; we will post updates in the app every few hours. To help you plan, from this week eligible direct deposits can arrive up to 2 days early. Your deposits stay FDIC-insured up to the standard limit. We never ask for passwords or codes by text.
decisions.why:
We tell customers first, before rivals and the standard notice, and give them a plan for the Friday Dec 11 payday.
Early pay and a $250 offline limit remove the two biggest pains of a read-only weekend; 150 extra staff absorb the questions.
Costs $1.3M and keeps $2.7M for what we cannot foresee; no promise we cannot keep (end time is 'about', with updates).

actions.action: Savings rate boost for 4 weeks, balances up to $50,000

decisions.message: Thank you for banking with us through our system upgrade. For the next 4 weeks, through January 10, we are adding 0.50 percentage points to your savings rate on balances up to $50,000. Nothing to sign up for. After January 10 your rate returns to our standard rate. Your deposits stay FDIC-insured up to the standard limit.
decisions.why:
Half of deposits sit with 5% of customers who compare rates weekly; this closes the 0.5-point gap right after the upgrade, when they decide.
Starting in week 7, the 4 weeks end on January 10, the day the board measures deposits.
Costs $1.6M, inside the menu and budget; the end date is stated, so nothing is misleading.
